verdict.rationale: Semgrep documents its own background automation: event-triggered scans on push and pull-request events via CI jobs, Semgrep Managed Scans that bulk-scan repositories without CI changes, and automatic PR comments and alerts on findings. These automations are limited to security scanning workflows and rely heavily on the CI provider; there is no evidence of user-defined agentic automations or recurring schedules. Missing for 10: documented recurring/scheduled scan configuration, general-purpose or AI-agent-driven background automations beyond scanning, independent hands-on corroboration of Managed Scans.
